title: Running late
blurb: One tap from a widget on your home screen. The text is on its way before you reach the door.
summary: Widget → "Running about 10 minutes late. Sorry! I'm on my way."

macros.name: Running late
macros.body: Running about 10 minutes late. Sorry! I'm on my way.

title: Good morning
blurb: A weekday good-morning that greets each person by their contact name.

title: Good morning, never the same
blurb: Same idea, but Gemini rewrites it every time, so nobody gets the same text twice. You approve each one before it goes. Needs a free Gemini key.
summary: Every day 08:00 · ✦ AI variation · ask me first

macros.name: Good morning (AI-fresh)
macros.ai: Warm and short, one or two sentences. Never use the same wording twice.

title: Out of office
blurb: Everyone who texts you gets a polite answer while you're away. Add an end date in the editor and it switches itself off.
summary: Incoming text → "Thanks for your message! I'm out of office…"

macros.name: Out of office
macros.body: Thanks for your message! I'm out of office and will get back to you as soon as I can. If it's urgent, please call.

title: Driving
blurb: Tell people why you're not answering. Switch it on when you leave, off when you arrive.
summary: Incoming text → "I'm driving right now and will reply when I stop. 🚗"

macros.name: Driving
macros.body: I'm driving right now and will reply when I stop. 🚗 If it's urgent, please call.

title: Missed-call text-back
blurb: When you can't pick up, the caller gets a text seconds later. Made for tradespeople, salons, meetings and school pickup.
summary: Missed call → "Sorry I missed your call. I'll call you back…"

macros.name: Missed call text-back
macros.body: Hi! Sorry I missed your call. I'll call you back as soon as I can. If it's quick, feel free to text me here.

title: Weekly reminder
blurb: Practice, pickup, bin day. The same reminder to the same people every week, without you typing it again.

macros.name: Weekly reminder
macros.body: Reminder: practice tonight at 18:30. See you there! 🙌

title: Quiet nights
blurb: Not a text at all: TextFox also runs your phone's sound mode. Do Not Disturb goes on at 22:00 and off at 07:00, every night. Two macros in one file.
